P01.rationale: A large portrait of a person (the client/subject) occupies roughly the upper-left half of the page, making it a dominant visual anchor, though it is a client rather than a founder figure.

P05.rationale: The client (GoldmanTax) is shown in a clearly framed, named portrait at meaningful size with name and company label beneath, though it is a video-still rather than a formal headshot.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block visible on the page.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears before the testimonial text on the right column, but it is modest in scale and the only decorative typographic element present.

P11.rationale: A real before/after horizontal bar chart comparing go-live durations (8 months vs. 2 months) is present and bound to specific numeric data.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large portrait, structured body text sections, a chart, and large metric callouts, though the lower-right area feels somewhat sparse.

P13.rationale: The background is largely flat/off-white with minimal texture; there is no deliberate atmospheric treatment beyond a light warm tint.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo does not have full-bleed text overlay; text is placed in separate white-background columns, so readability is maintained without needing a scrim.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real, specific individual (named client) rather than generic stock imagery, lending reasonable specificity.

N08.rationale: The lower-right quadrant below the testimonial quote is noticeably empty, creating a moderate dead-space region, though the rest of the page is adequately filled.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo without a scrim; the image and text occupy separate, clearly delineated zones.
